documents_single_owner_check.name: documents_single_owner_check
documents_single_owner_check.value: (CASE WHEN "documents"."resident_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN "documents"."application_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

deletion_quarantines_cancellation_fields.name: deletion_quarantines_cancellation_fields_check
deletion_quarantines_cancellation_fields.value:
("deletion_quarantines"."status" in ('quarantined', 'purging') and "deletion_quarantines"."canceled_at" is null and "deletion_quarantines"."canceled_by" is null and "deletion_quarantines"."cancellation_reason" is null)
        or ("deletion_quarantines"."status" = 'canceled' and "deletion_quarantines"."canceled_at" is not null and "deletion_quarantines"."canceled_by" is not null and "deletion_quarantines"."cancellation_reason" is not null)
        or ("deletion_quarantines"."status" = 'purged' and "deletion_quarantines"."canceled_at" is null and "deletion_quarantines"."canceled_by" is null and "deletion_quarantines"."cancellation_reason" is null)

legal_holds_release_fields_check.name: legal_holds_release_fields_check
legal_holds_release_fields_check.value:
("legal_holds"."status" = 'active' and "legal_holds"."released_at" is null and "legal_holds"."released_by" is null and "legal_holds"."release_reason" is null)
        or ("legal_holds"."status" = 'released' and "legal_holds"."released_at" is not null and "legal_holds"."released_by" is not null and "legal_holds"."release_reason" is not null)
